baseline_prompt_en: Make a photorealistic ethereal gothic photograph in which serene stillness, floral forms and dark ornament belong to the same present moment. It is a connected, complex present-tense scene at a stopped old city tram at its final turning loop, just after rain. The subject is a woman guided by the supplied photograph, portrayed here as a fictional adult flower-delivery traveler. Her visible facial proportions, jaw-length dark bob and light separated forehead fringe follow the supplied photograph. She stands fully inside the carriage beside the open door, absorbed in the cargo rather than performing for the viewer. A shallow charcoal travel case rests across a brass luggage shelf at her waist, with its opened packing cloth slipping over the nearer edge. Several ivory-flowered branches lie diagonally within the case; one delicate twig has leaned toward the doorway during the arrival. Her left palm supports the near underside of the case while her right fingertips cradle that twig at its bare stem, drawing its flowers back over the case. The case remains supported by the shelf as the petals settle close to her hand. Her shoulders stay relaxed, her upper body inclines gently toward this small task, and her eyes follow the stem. A soft, slightly parted mouth and quiet, inward attention make the pause intimate without turning it into a display. She wears a high-collared black botanical lace blouse, its embroidered stems following the natural folds at her shoulder and bent elbow, with a faded black skirt. A small dark floral clasp at the collar echoes the cargo's living blossoms. The tram's curved black iron door surround and worn gilt edging bring ornament into a practical space; rain beads on the farther window and the curved rail beyond the door identify the journey's end. Warm light from an end-of-line lamp brushes a narrow vertical band along the brass door jamb, the bob's outer edge and the pale petals. Misted window light spreads a softer ivory fill across her face, leaving layered charcoal shadows in the carriage. From the platform, the capture camera sees her at chest height in a three-quarter medium portrait, including her head, both hands, the entire case and the door threshold. A natural 50mm perspective holds face, hand-to-stem contact and lace clearly while the turning-loop rail softens behind them. The eye travels from her face to the stabilizing hands and blossoms, then to the threshold where the delivery can continue. Muted antique gold, warm ivory and faded blacks, gentle tonal roll-off, natural skin texture and a fine photographic grain preserve the hush of this arrival.
